car_model_needs_make.name: car_model_needs_make
car_model_needs_make.value: "car"."model_key" IS NULL OR "car"."make_key" IS NOT NULL

car_seed_offsets_seed_only.name: car_seed_offsets_seed_only
car_seed_offsets_seed_only.value: "car"."seed_offsets" IS NULL OR "car"."seed_key" IS NOT NULL

car_copy_in_session.name: car_copy_in_session
car_copy_in_session.value: "car"."copied_from_car_id" IS NULL OR "car"."demo_session_id" IS NOT NULL

car_battery_soh_source.name: car_battery_soh_source
car_battery_soh_source.value: "car"."battery_soh_pct" IS NULL OR "car"."battery_soh_source" IS NOT NULL

car_published_at_set.name: car_published_at_set
car_published_at_set.value: "car"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'reserved', 'sold') OR "car"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

dealer_settings_coordinates.name: dealer_settings_coordinates
dealer_settings_coordinates.value: ("dealer_settings"."lat" IS NULL) = ("dealer_settings"."lng" IS NULL) AND "dealer_settings"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "dealer_settings"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180

dealer_settings_unit_prices_range.name: dealer_settings_unit_prices_range
dealer_settings_unit_prices_range.value: "dealer_settings"."fuel_price_90" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."fuel_price_95" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."fuel_price_98" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."fuel_price_diesel" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."elec_home_offpeak_kwh" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."elec_home_peak_kwh" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5 AND "dealer_settings"."elec_public_kwh" BETWEEN 0.05 AND 5

media_peaks_shape.name: media_peaks_shape
media_peaks_shape.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("media"."peaks") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("media"."peaks") = 200 ELSE "media"."peaks" IS NULL END

media_audio_fields.name: media_audio_fields
media_audio_fields.value: "media"."kind" = 'engine_audio' OR ("media"."audio_source" IS NULL AND "media"."audio_clip_type" IS NULL)

media_ready_registered.name: media_ready_registered
media_ready_registered.value: "media"."status" = 'pending' OR ("media"."variants" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."mime" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."bytes" IS NOT NULL)

media_ready_size.name: media_ready_size
media_ready_size.value: "media"."kind" NOT IN ('photo', 'spin_frame', 'og_image', 'blueprint', 'logo') OR "media"."status" = 'pending' OR ("media"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."height" IS NOT NULL)

media_ready_audio.name: media_ready_audio
media_ready_audio.value: "media"."kind" <> 'engine_audio' OR "media"."status" = 'pending' OR ("media"."audio_source" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."audio_clip_type" IS NOT NULL)

place_owner.name: place_owner
place_owner.value: "place"."is_preset" = ("place"."dealer_id" IS NULL) AND NOT ("place"."is_preset" AND "place"."demo_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

place_preset_complete.name: place_preset_complete
place_preset_complete.value: NOT "place"."is_preset" OR ("place"."key" IS NOT NULL AND "place"."country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "place"."lat" IS NOT NULL AND "place"."kind" IS NOT NULL)

place_coordinates.name: place_coordinates
place_coordinates.value: ("place"."lat" IS NULL) = ("place"."lng" IS NULL) AND "place"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "place"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180

spin_hotspot_note_present.name: spin_hotspot_note_present
spin_hotspot_note_present.value: "spin_hotspot"."note_ar" IS NOT NULL OR "spin_hotspot"."note_en" IS NOT NULL
